title: Written Complaint to Station House Officer / SP under Section 173(1) and 173(4) BNSS, 2023 for Registration of FIR
whenToUse: Use when reporting cognizable criminal offenses (cheating, criminal breach of trust, forgery, intimidation) to the Police for registration of FIR under Section 173 BNSS, 2023.
variantComparisonNote: Primary police complaint under Section 173(1) BNSS. If refused, escalate to SP under 173(4) BNSS, or file Section 175(3) BNSS application before Magistrate.
youWillNeed: Identity proof of complainant, documentary evidence of financial transaction/contract, communication screenshots, call records, Section 63 BSA certificate.
legalBasis: Section 173(1) & 173(4) Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS); Lalita Kumari v. Govt of UP (2014); Sections 316, 318, 336, 351 Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (BNS).
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Disclosure of cognizable offense under Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Clear identity, address, and overt acts of named accused persons
Date, time, and specific location of incident within territorial jurisdiction
Preservation of digital evidence under Section 63 of Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023

particulars.label: Police Station & Officer
particulars.description: Designation of SHO and Police Station

particulars.label: Date of Incident / Offense
particulars.description: Date or period during which crime occurred

aiBlocks.title: Narrative of Cognizable Incident
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate chronological facts establishing deceptive inducement, dishonest misappropriation, and specific overt acts of each accused.

aiBlocks.title: Applicable Penal Provisions under BNS 2023
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Invoke specific penal sections of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (e.g. Sec 316 criminal breach of trust, Sec 318 cheating, Sec 61 criminal conspiracy) and demonstrate ingredients.

aiBlocks.title: Prayer for Immediate FIR & Investigation
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Demand immediate registration of FIR under Section 173(1) BNSS, seizure of incriminating material, arrest of accused, and issuance of free copy of FIR.
